tools.name: get_help
tools.description: Forge how-to on demand (no project needed): propose→adopt, what a System is, Balance Lab formats, sign-in. Call when unsure.

tools.name: get_workflow
tools.description: Run FIRST in a new repo (no project): first-connect routine + the working-agreement block to ADD to AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md now (tell the user in one line; remove if they object).

tools.name: import_from_code
tools.description: One-command codebase import: recipe + batch id — propose one Context overview + one System per real module; the owner adopts all at once.

tools.name: design_ui_from_systems
tools.description: Recipe to design the UI from Systems (user request only): steps + batch id — confirm canvas aspect, then screens + PLACED elements + edges in one batch.

tools.name: post_log
tools.description: Append a build-log entry to Activity — what you built/decided (commit-note style).

tools.name: get_project_context
tools.description: FULL design dump — LARGE, last resort; prefer get_project_meta + list_*/get_*/search.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Projects your key reaches (id, name, role); pass an id as project_id to switch.

tools.name: get_project_meta
tools.description: START HERE. Tiny overview: counts, members, task claims + working_now (avoid collisions), forge_workflow_version.

tools.name: trace_ui_from_image
tools.description: SECONDARY (user-driven UI): turn a screen's REFERENCE IMAGE into placed elements. Returns the image itself plus the recipe — the canvas resolution, the fraction→pixel conversion that stops coordinates landing wrong, and what is already on the screen so a second pass updates instead of duplicating. Y

tools.name: get_stale
tools.description: What has drifted between the Idea lane and the System Specs — the design's own out-of-sync list, computed deterministically (no AI, no tokens). Three kinds: Idea notes edited since the systems were generated from them (with the systems each one touches), Idea notes whose prose the systems have moved

tools.name: resync_from_idea
tools.description: The recipe for re-syncing ONE changed Idea note into the specs that depend on it — the same scoped job the app's "Re-sync N systems" button does, minus the button. Returns the note, the affected specs in full, and exactly how to send the result back. You do the writing; it lands in the owner's Inbox

tools.name: get_design_document
tools.description: The WHOLE design as one readable document — Vision (+ Project DNA) → every System spec → reference notes, compiled deterministically from the current design. Read this to understand a project end-to-end instead of walking list_systems → get_system N times. Returns markdown plus the project `version`

tools.name: set_design_overview
tools.description: Write the Design Document's Overview — the human-readable page a new team member reads first. WRITES DIRECTLY (no Inbox): it is a derived, clearly-labelled AI summary, not design truth, and the owner can clear or rewrite it in one click. HARD RULES, same as the in-app button: use ONLY facts stated i

tools.name: get_briefing
tools.description: ONE-CALL orientation before you build: pass `files` you're about to edit (or a `task`) → the systems that own them, each with Goal + Acceptance + build status/files/last_commit/drift + coupled_systems (code neighbors an edit may break) + pending Inbox changes + recent decisions, plus open-rejection

tools.name: get_system
tools.description: ONE system's full spec (Goal/Boundary/Acceptance, markdown, sources, status) + pending Inbox changes touching it.

tools.name: list_systems
tools.description: All systems, compact: id, name, status, 1-line goal.

tools.name: get_build_region
tools.description: System→code map per built system: implementing files, status, drift flag, last_commit, and acceptance-evidence COUNTS. Mapped files gone from the repo? report_drift. Pass `system:"<name|id>"` for ONE system plus the full text of its acceptance criteria (omitted from the map — it is the bulk of the p

tools.name: report_drift
tools.description: Flag CODE DRIFT — mapped files no longer match the repo. Advisory; a fresh report_build_status clears it.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: DESIGN MEMORY: recorded decisions/logs/rejections with who/when. Read BEFORE changing a system's direction; empty = no recorded WHY — don't invent one.

tools.name: get_impact
tools.description: BLAST RADIUS of a system (deterministic): upstream context, siblings, dependent screens/milestones, files, code-coupled systems, pending Inbox, recent activity. Run BEFORE changing it.

tools.name: get_rejections
tools.description: Owner's DECLINED list — check at session start; follow each entry's guidance, then resolve_rejection(title).

tools.name: resolve_rejection
tools.description: Report you REVERTED a declined change (unlocks the owner's Clear). Call after realigning the build.

tools.name: list_screens
tools.description: All screens, compact: id, name, purpose, status.

tools.name: get_screen
tools.description: ONE screen's layout: canvas `resolution` (use THESE px), elements x/y/w/h, links, popups. Read before editing a screen. has_reference_image:true → get_screen_image shows you the actual image.

tools.name: get_screen_image
tools.description: A screen's reference image (HUD background) as an actual IMAGE you can see — reads the stored file inline (signed-URL fallback past 4MB).

tools.name: update_element
tools.description: Move/resize/relabel an element — DIRECT, live. element_id (preferred) or screen+label; x+y also places an unplaced one.

tools.name: withdraw_proposal
tools.description: Remove YOUR OWN still-pending Inbox item (id from the propose response / get_inbox).

tools.name: delete_entity
tools.description: PROPOSE a delete → Inbox (owner adopts; nothing deleted now). id preferred or exact name; flow_edge may use from+to.

tools.name: dedupe
tools.description: Remove duplicate-named entries (keep first) — DIRECT, destructive.

tools.name: reorder
tools.description: Reorder milestones / tasks / elements — DIRECT. order = ids in new order; omitted keep relative order.

tools.name: list_milestones
tools.description: All milestones, compact: id, name, weeks, order, done/total.

tools.name: get_milestone
tools.description: ONE milestone: goal, weeks, difficulty, systems, every task (id/name/done/status/effort).

tools.name: list_activity
tools.description: Change history {who, change, entity, kind, when}, newest first; filter kind/who/query.

tools.name: get_inbox
tools.description: PENDING Inbox (the owner's triage queue). Check BEFORE proposing — avoid duplicates. Read-only.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Keyword search — compact hits {kind, id, name} + snippet.

tools.name: propose_system
tools.description: Propose a NEW system → Inbox. spec = ## Goal / ## Boundary (Owns · Doesn't own) / ## Acceptance. Exists? use update_system. (Alias: create_proposal.)

tools.name: propose_context
tools.description: Propose a new/updated Idea note → Inbox. Title-match to update; send the COMPLETE revised text. Set resync:true ONLY when you rewrote the note FROM the current systems (get_stale lists notes the systems have moved past) — it stops the adopted note from immediately nagging to re-generate the systems

tools.name: propose_dna
tools.description: Propose Project DNA and/or Tech Notes → Inbox (at least one).

tools.name: update_system
tools.description: Propose a system UPDATE → Inbox diff. get_system first; send the FULL revised spec. new_title renames; context_title+context bundles the Idea update. Set resync:true ONLY when you rewrote this spec FROM its upstream Idea (see resync_from_idea) — it re-stamps the staleness signal on adopt.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Read Balance Lab: stat tables, boards with EVALUATED values, scenarios.

tools.name: propose_balance_table
tools.description: Propose a stat-doc TABLE → Inbox. csv (header; `key%` = percent; first column = name) OR schema+rows. Adopting REPLACES same-named.

tools.name: propose_balance_board
tools.description: Propose a node board → Inbox. Kinds const|formula|item|sheet|loadout|picker|pool|process|note|frame; formulas reference blocks by NAME; omit x/y = auto-layout. Adopting REPLACES same-named.

tools.name: propose_milestone
tools.description: Propose a NEW milestone (+ optional tasks) → Inbox.

tools.name: report_milestone_progress
tools.description: Mark existing-milestone tasks done → Inbox progress card (owner adopts the ticks).

tools.name: report_build_status
tools.description: Report a SYSTEM's status (todo|in-progress|implemented) — DIRECT, live. ALWAYS pass files (full list — it REPLACES); non-todo with no files shows done-but-EMPTY. 'implemented' counts as VERIFIED only when every UNIT-TESTABLE ## Acceptance bullet is backed via evidence[{criterion,proof}]; a bullet ta

tools.name: propose_flow_edge
tools.description: SECONDARY (user-driven UI): propose a link between two existing screens → Inbox.

tools.name: propose_element
tools.description: SECONDARY (user-driven UI): propose an element onto a screen → Inbox. ALWAYS pass x/y/w/h (px on the screen's `resolution` from get_screen); no coords = unplaced pile.

tools.name: propose_screen
tools.description: SECONDARY (user-driven UI): propose a NEW screen → Inbox. parent = popup over that screen; purpose grounds AI suggestions. Whole UI? design_ui_from_systems first.

tools.name: report_screen_status
tools.description: Report a SCREEN's status (todo|in-progress|implemented) → Inbox.

tools.name: rename_screen
tools.description: Rename a screen IN PLACE — DIRECT; links/elements follow (id-referenced).

tools.name: update_milestone
tools.description: Edit milestone goal/weeks/difficulty/name — DIRECT. new_name renames (never delete+recreate).

tools.name: add_task
tools.description: Add a task to a milestone — DIRECT. assignee:"me" claims on creation.

tools.name: next_task
tools.description: DISPATCHER (multi-agent): atomically pick + claim the next task to build — walks milestones in order, skips human-only tasks and any task whose systems share code files with a task another agent already holds or is actively touching, so parallel agents spread out instead of colliding. Returns the cl

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Edit a task or CLAIM it — DIRECT. assignee:"me"+status:"in-progress" claims (errors if held; force:true for stale); done:true or assignee:"" releases.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "forge-mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: set_design_overview, get_briefing, get_system, get_impact, get_screen_image, get_inbox · Private data: get_stale, get_design_document, set_design_overview, get_briefing, get_build_region, report_drift, get_impact, get_screen_image, report_build_status, next_task · Public sink: post_log, trace_ui_from_image, resync_from_idea, propose_context, update_system, next_task · Destructive: get_workflow, get_impact, withdraw_proposal, delete_entity, dedupe, report_build_status, update_milestone.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: set_design_overview, get_briefing, get_system, get_impact, get_screen_image, get_inbox · Private data: get_stale, get_design_document, set_design_overview, get_briefing, get_build_region, report_drift, get_impact, get_screen_image, report_build_status, next_task · Public sink: post_log, trace_ui_from_image, resync_from_idea, propose_context, update_system, next_task · Destructive: get_workflow, get_impact, withdraw_proposal, delete_entity, dedupe, report_build_status, update_milestone

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
